summary: Verify-only round 2. The CW6-owned fixes hold when re-measured. Marund's recall hand.L max step is 0.075 m per 60 Hz frame (was 0.498). Sukri's recall is 6 s with head travel 23.1 cm, and his idle head travel is 5.1 cm. card_qa re-run: 48 cards, 0 misses (Rishal Chalkline splash MAD 35.1, First Bell portrait MAD 40.5). Ilsheta's lamp now sits beside her face on all 3 busts and in the game-camera idle. Marund's busts show the dome windows. The wave still fails.
